acceptance: The baseline JSON records timing method 2 and was generated by scripts/perf_smoke_baseline.py from the five listed artifacts; .sources.json lists them and names the selection rule used
perf_smoke_baseline.py refuses sources with mixed or missing timing methods, and applies the max fallback only when no CPU model has five results (unit tests for both, failing on the old behaviour)
Replaying each source artifact through the exact nightly compare command against the new baseline exits 0 and the comparison actually runs
Noise floors recomputed from method-2 data and documented; workflow thresholds match the doc
Decision gate: if a replay shows a >10% regression beyond the floors, or fewer than five method-2 artifacts are usable, stop and report to the owner instead of loosening floors
context: Guardrails: work only in linked worktrees; never git add -A; Joe Harris identity, no agent trailers; no explanatory code/YAML comments (make comment-policy-check); no new CI skips, no required-check renames, no ruleset/settings/secret changes; no weakening of an existing check beyond the rule this item names; durable commit text without tracker ids. Do not change benchbox compare semantics or allow cross-method comparison.
description:
t3:perf cannot compare: the baseline is timing method 1 (missing run.timing_method means legacy), DuckDB results are method 2 since PR #4080. Rebuild the baseline under method 2, recompute both noise floors with the documented 1.25x rule, and make scripts/perf_smoke_baseline.py reject sources whose timing methods differ or are missing, recording the method in the baseline.

Owner decision 2026-11-17 (selection rule): the documented rule (slowest CPU model with at least five results) cannot be met: the five method-2 artifacts span four CPU models (EPYC 7763 x2, Xeon 8573C, Xeon 6975P-C, EPYC 9V74; totals 261-286 ms). Add a fallback to the generator and doc: use the slowest model with at least five results when one exists; otherwise take the per-query maximum over at least five method-2 runs of any model, and record which rule was used in the sources ledger. The final PR waits for this member.

Inputs: t3-perf-result artifacts of nightly runs 43254687916, 43453477982, 43604460150, 43726725879, 43916000915 (gh run download).

Scope: _project/baselines/perf_smoke_duckdb_tpch_001*.json, scripts/perf_smoke_baseline.py, tests/unit/scripts/test_perf_smoke_baseline.py, docs/internal/perf-smoke.md, and the compare thresholds in .github/workflows/nightly-v2.yml only if the recomputed floors differ.
